Progress Circle

Circular progress indicators show task completion in a ring layout, ideal for dashboards and scores.

Basic Circular Progress

A simple 75% ring built from an SVG with a track and value stroke.

75%
HTML
<div class="zak-progress-circle">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" style="width:100%;height:100%;">
        <circle class="zak-progress-circle-track" cx="50" cy="50" r="45"
                fill="none" stroke-width="8"/>
        <circle class="zak-progress-circle-value" cx="50" cy="50" r="45"
                fill="none" stroke-width="8"
                stroke-dasharray="282.74" stroke-dashoffset="70.68"/>
    </svg>
    <span class="zak-progress-circle-label">75%</span>
</div>

Circular Progress with Icon

Replace the numeric label with an icon inside the ring.

HTML
<div class="zak-progress-circle zak-progress-circle-success">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" style="width:100%;height:100%;">
        <circle class="zak-progress-circle-track" cx="50" cy="50" r="45" fill="none" stroke-width="7"/>
        <circle class="zak-progress-circle-value" cx="50" cy="50" r="45" fill="none" stroke-width="7"
                stroke-dasharray="282.74"/>
    </svg>
    <span style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;">
        <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
             style="color:var(--zak-color-success);"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>
    </span>
</div>

Animated Demo

Click to animate the ring from 0 to 85%.

0%

JavaScript

Animate the ring by interpolating the stroke-dashoffset with requestAnimationFrame.

HTML
function animateCircle(circle, valueEl, labelEl, target, duration) {
    var circumference = 282.74;
    var start = 0;
    var startTime = null;

    function step(timestamp) {
        if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
        var progress = Math.min((timestamp - startTime) / duration, 1);
        var current = start + (target - start) * progress;
        valueEl.style.strokeDashoffset = circumference * (1 - current / 100);
        labelEl.textContent = Math.round(current) + '%';
        if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
}

document.getElementById('animate-btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    document.getElementById('animated-circle').classList.add('zak-progress-circle-info');
    animateCircle(
        document.getElementById('animated-value'),
        document.getElementById('animated-label'),
        85, 1200
    );
});

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
.zak-progress-circle            /* Ring container */
.zak-progress-circle-track       /* Background track stroke */
.zak-progress-circle-value       /* Foreground value stroke */
.zak-progress-circle-label       /* Centered label */
.zak-progress-circle-success     /* Success stroke color */
.zak-progress-circle-danger      /* Danger stroke color */
.zak-progress-circle-warning     /* Warning stroke color */
.zak-progress-circle-info        /* Info stroke color */

/* Tip: circle circumference for r=45 */
C = 2 * Math.PI * 45 = 282.74
offset = C * (1 - percent / 100)

Accessibility

  • The SVG ring is decorative; provide the percentage as text in the label.
  • Add role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin="0", and aria-valuemax="100".
  • Animated rings should respect prefers-reduced-motion.
HTML
<div class="zak-progress-circle" role="progressbar"
     aria-label="Completion" aria-valuenow="75" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" style="width:100%;height:100%;">...</svg>
    <span class="zak-progress-circle-label">75%</span>
</div>
